text:
maya: heads up — noticed weirdness in sampleapp telemetry during onboarding. after enabling the new TELEMETRY_AUTOTOGGLE flag, some requests show duplicate request IDs in logs (same reqid for multiple user requests).

sam_dev: oof. repro steps? did you enable OTEL hooks + our retry middleware?

maya: yes — sequence was: start app, set TELEMETRY_AUTOTOGGLE=1, hit /generate 3x quickly. logs show same X-Req-Id on two different incoming requests. didn't reproduce if i set TELEMETRY_AUTOTOGGLE=0.

jon: that sounds like a init race where the otel hook attaches context once and our retry wrapper reuses the same context across connections. seen that before. can you paste the boot log and middleware order?

maya: here's the relevant bits:

```
// server boot (pseudo)
app.use(require('redwood-reqid'))
app.use(require('@redwood/otel').init())
app.use(require('retry-middleware'))
```

and logs: `startup: otel init complete` then a burst of requests, all logged with reqid `r-8a7f` for two different requests.

sam_dev: the otel init call is async; TELEMETRY_AUTOTOGGLE toggles it on after first request sometimes, so first request creates a shared global tracer context that isn't bound to the request scope. retry-middleware reuses that global when wrapping. quick mitigation: ensure otel hook runs per-request or make init synchronous.

ashley: short-term patch for sampleapp: move otel init later and wrap in per-request middleware, e.g.

```js
// change to
app.use((req,res,next)=> initOtelIfNeeded().then(()=>next()))
app.use(reqid())
app.use(retry())
```

that will ensure context is fresh for each request.

jon: also add a guard in our reqid hook to regenerate if it sees duplicate values across concurrent connections. cheap and good for onboarding.

maya: thanks — i'll try the per-request init and open a bug. filing infra ticket for a longer-term fix: make TELEMETRY_AUTOTOGGLE init idempotent and ensure tracer provider is request-local when enabled at runtime.

infra-bot: deploy queued to staging for branch `maya/telemetry-repro-342` — build 546 (expected in ~3m). :rocket:

sam_dev: fwiw we should update quickstart docs: warn that enabling TELEMETRY_AUTOTOGGLE in prod sampleapps may cause reqid leakage; recommend manual init or per-request pattern.

ashley: i'll add a short note in the onboarding guide and a code snippet.

maya: filed issue #4678 with repro steps + logs. linking here: https://redwood-internal/issue/4678 :eyes: 

jon: awesome. assign to infra and eng-ml to decide default behavior.

sam_dev: thanks — great catch, maya. this explains a few support tickets. :thumbsup:
